Basic chat completion request routed through the proxy

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
